events.title: Demo Ver 1.4 Update
events.summary: ◇ Dungeon System Overhaul The dungeon system has been completely redesigned (the previous system has been removed). You now choose your route on a map, which reduces the influence of luck and makes your choices more strategic. Visual effects have also been greatly enhanced for a more immersive experience. * About existing save data If you load a save made partway through the dungeon, the map will start over from Layer 1. events.title: "Dungeon Picnic" Demo Now Available for a Limited Time!
events.summary: The demo lets you play through the first area and use four playable characters.Because some specifications differ, save data cannot be carried over to the full version.This demo is also confirmed for Steam Next Fest, starting October 19!Development toward the full release is well underway, so please look forward to further updates.Streaming GuidelinesLive streams of the "Dungeon Picnic" demo are welcome on all video platforms.Monetization features on those platforms (such as YouTube Super Chat)
